exercises.prompt: Buat revenue, gabungkan category dari Products, lalu ringkas total revenue per category.
exercises.incorrect_feedback: Hubungkan tabel melalui product_id, lalu gunakan groupby category dan sum untuk revenue.
exercises.success_feedback: Tepat. Kamu menyatakan dimension dan measure sebelum membuat ringkasan.

interactive.starter_code:
import pandas as pd

transactions = pd.read_csv("transactions.csv")
products = pd.read_csv("products.csv")
transactions["revenue"] = transactions["quantity"] * transactions["unit_price"]
sales = transactions.merge(products, on="product_id", how="left")
summary = sales.groupby("category", as_index=False)["revenue"].sum().sort_values("revenue", ascending=False)
print(summary)
